title: When Gamification Spoils Your Learning: A Qualitative Case Study of Gamification Misuse in a Language-Learning App
reasoning: The paper identifies 'Threatening Ethics' as one of the three primary ramifications of gamification misuse. It specifically evaluates user perceptions of unfairness and learning misconduct (e.g., cheating and manipulation), making ethical impact a core component of the qualitative study rather than just a boilerplate considerations section.
